rank01_limitation: One instance cannot support instance-robustness claims.

burden_reference.interpretation: estimate only; instance-dependent variation is unknown

options.A_continue_unchanged: value for robustness, but high and poorly decomposed burden
options.B_pause_for_runtime_diagnosis: recommended; preserves scientific scope while investigating the 99.8% unassigned wall time
options.C_stop_after_rank01: defensible if limited evidence is sufficient, but loses instance-robustness information

decision_basis: The marginal value of two additional instances is real, but should be weighed after runtime diagnosis because rank01 consumed more than 42 hours and approximately 201.6 GiB peak RSS.
